events.name: Dominique Hammons Soul Sessions
events.info: Dominique Hammons is a dynamic violinist known for blending classical technique with contemporary styles including hip-hop, R&B, jazz, gospel, and soul. With an electrifying stage presence and a passion for innovation, Hammons has become recognized for redefining what modern violin performance can sound and feel like. His music bridges generations and genres, bringing a fresh, energetic approach to the violin while remaining rooted in strong musical artistry. Raised with a deep appreciation for music and performance, Dominique began playing violin at a young age and quickly developed a reputation for his expressive playing style and versatility. Rather than staying confined to traditional classical performance, he expanded his artistry by incorporating improvisation, modern production, and contemporary rhythms into his sound. This unique fusion has allowed him to connect with diverse audiences across concert halls, festivals, community events, and digital platforms.

events.name: World Ballet Company:The Sleeping Beauty With A Live Orchestra
events.info: Experience the enchanting world of The Sleeping Beauty in a breathtaking new production from World Ballet Company, featuring a LIVE orchestra. This magical performance features forty professional dancers, over 150 radiant costumes, stunning hand-crafted sets and multimedia effects. Tchaikovsky's glorious score will be performed live. Follow Princess Aurora from her joyful christening to the wicked fairy Carabosse's powerful curse, the kingdom's enchanted hundred-year sleep, and the magical kiss that awakens the sleeping beauty. From the iconic Rose Adagio to the grand wedding celebration, every moment is filled with beauty and wonder.Share an unforgettable evening where fairy tales come to life, love conquers darkness, and happily ever after awaits.
